module: Manages the GuiCanvas (the render window) on the client side: one-time creation of the "Canvas" object and showing/hiding the mouse cursor. Called at game startup (initializeCanvas); a modder can use showCursor/hideCursor to release or lock the mouse.
notes: createCanvas reuses the "Canvas" object if it already exists in the scenetree; otherwise it creates it with displayWindow = false.
If the variable $forceFullscreen is true, $pref::Video::displayOutputDevice is cleared; if $pref::Video::autoDetect is true, core_settings_graphic.autoDetectApplyGraphicsQuality() is called.
showCursor and hideCursor also call lockMouse (false / true) in addition to changing the canvas cursor's visibility.

canvasCreated.desc: True once the canvas has been created by initializeCanvas; prevents a second creation.

createCanvas.desc: Returns the GuiCanvas object "Canvas", creating and registering it if it does not exist. Applies the fullscreen and graphics auto-detection preferences.

windowPlacement.desc: Window placement; not used in the function body (inferred from code).

initializeCanvas.desc: Creates the canvas only once (logs an error if already created), reads WindowPlacement from the graphics options, and calls quit() if creation fails.

returns.desc: The canvas, or nil if already created.

showCursor.desc: Unlocks the mouse (lockMouse(false)) and makes the canvas cursor visible.

hideCursor.desc: Locks the mouse (lockMouse(true)) and hides the canvas cursor.
